clauses.oldAuthority: Raw thunk/value C locals, SFUN_ARG and marker setup choreographies
clauses.replacement: Generated NativeActivation root/borrow plan plus stable VM-owned root origin, before any collecting conversion
clauses.condition: Cover both run origins, generated SFUN/CFUN, RC writes and nested exceptional exits; a pointer to an unregistered local is not a root
clauses.retirement: Retire raw managed-entry choreography only when every admitted generator and native user calls the same plan; unmanaged ABI stays explicitly outside optimized admission
clauses.custody: Registration failure leaves parent roots owned; unknown acknowledgement retains source and destination until queried; startup rooted adapter is existing partial progress
clauses.memoryOrder: Root metadata initialized under origin gate; release-ready publication and acquire validation precede consuming handles; no collecting operation with an incomplete view
clauses.savedWork: Remove per-caller reinvention and stale-local recovery attempts; root scanning remains necessary
clauses.addedCost: Activation/origin records, root register and post-GC reload; retained payload graphs not bounded by fixed records

clauses.oldAuthority: PSTATE index and synchronous barrier imply complete membership and root stability
clauses.replacement: RoundCoordinator snapshots admitted RootOrigins with incarnations and frozen views independently of OS carrier population
clauses.condition: Freeze all root writers/borrowers; registration racing close belongs wholly to this round or retains source for next admission; return cannot mutate an unscanned included view
clauses.retirement: Remove participant-array-by-carrier construction after all resize, GC and callback admissions publish through one root registry and round gate
clauses.custody: Late registration remains VM/parent-root owned and cannot wait for GC while holding a writer lease; no root disappears on a failed close
clauses.memoryOrder: Mutex release/acquire publishes member set and root view; claim CAS uses acquire-release; plain slot access occurs only under frozen/exclusive authority, not a revision-only race check
clauses.savedWork: Avoid equating every root origin with one runnable collector carrier
clauses.addedCost: Frozen-view metadata, registration arbitration and scanner pins; complete round closure remains required

clauses.replacement: RootTask names VM, round, origin slot/incarnation, kind and claim generation; worker execution identity supplies no participant authority
clauses.condition: One claim owner scans actual frozen root locations; root task completion differs from completion of descendants and of the full strong phase
clauses.retirement: Replace carrier indexing in strong, weak, cleanup and root dispatch together; keep OS identity only for host instrumentation
clauses.custody: Failed dequeue retains queue authority; unknown claim stays recorded in-flight; never recreate a second scanner from an empty queue observation
clauses.memoryOrder: Initialize task before release queue publication; acquire dequeue/claim, release result/root writes; coordinator acquires completion before phase advance
clauses.savedWork: Allow W workers to service R root origins without W=R or fixed carrier affinity
clauses.addedCost: Task claims, root-owner indirection and completion metadata; no automatic speedup when W exceeds useful work

clauses.oldAuthority: Collector allocation, tospace and private frontier use work->context and carrier PSTATE context memory macros
clauses.replacement: WorkerArena owns copied intervals, frontier, Tail and destination grants; ContextResumePlan separately owns restored mutator intervals
clauses.condition: Migrate reserve/cancel/commit, stack-frame copying, section refill, still accounting, steal victims and instrumentation; pre-flip physical plan covers copy and resume without overlap
clauses.retirement: Retire collector context allocation macros and synchronous binding assertion only after the entire allocator/scanner/helper call graph consumes work/round/arena explicitly
clauses.custody: Unpublished copy or Tail cannot be abandoned; rejected transfer retains donor; unknown stop retains source arena and forbids a second initializer
clauses.memoryOrder: Arena-exclusive ordinary writes; published object readiness and ownership use release/acquire; migration requires stopped donor plus matching generation, never timeout alone
clauses.savedWork: Decouple copying policy and worker count from Scheme context lifetime; eligible arena tails can feed resume plans
clauses.addedCost: Worker arenas, packing and handoff metadata; count simultaneous copy, resume and unknown-retained reserves at physical peak

clauses.oldAuthority: Processor zero and each carrier implicitly own VM roots, weak work, still sweep and shared overflow result
clauses.replacement: Round-scoped task keys and coordinator phase authorization; context root work and VM-global duties are different tasks
clauses.condition: VM roots/global variables scanned exactly as required; weak fixed point precedes cleanup; effects/affinity of foreign releases are admitted before movement/resume
clauses.retirement: Remove processor-zero semantic ownership and per-carrier weak/cleanup phase stores; host coordinator thread may remain a policy choice
clauses.custody: Owner-dependent release retains rooted deferred work and budget; collector never waits for callback execution forbidden by its own parked-owner policy
clauses.memoryOrder: Task and phase publication under round gate; release result before acquire acknowledgement; failure outcome is immutable for this round
clauses.savedWork: Remove accidental carrier duplication and owner-callback work from GC critical path when effects allow
clauses.addedCost: Explicit global/weak/release task accounting, effects checks and retained deferred payload

clauses.oldAuthority: scan_workers_count decrements and processor barriers imply no future scan producer
clauses.replacement: Closed producer set plus explicit queued, claimed, private-copy, Tail and descendant custody; stopped worker transfers its responsibilities
clauses.condition: Every publisher/last use is mapped; parent can finish only after children are durably accounted; handoff receipt proves custody rather than implying completed work
clauses.retirement: Retire idle-count-as-proof and fixed-population GC barriers together; waking/parking mechanisms can remain implementation details
clauses.custody: Unknown donor execution or publication leaves an in-flight debt; safeness can hold while progress is unresolved; cannot discharge debt by declaring carrier dead
clauses.memoryOrder: Reserve child debt before visibility; publish task then transfer authority; terminal transition serialized against producer admission; wait predicates checked under same gate
clauses.savedWork: Prevent premature completion and false all-worker participation requirements; permit scheduling independent from membership
clauses.addedCost: Debt/publication traffic and wakeup coordination; fairness and bounded external work remain separate assumptions

clauses.oldAuthority: Returning from identical per-processor GC barriers implies restored roots, capacity and overflow consumption
clauses.replacement: Whole-round resume seal plus context-specific physical allocation grant, authoritative root reload and immutable outcome receipt
clauses.condition: All required phases/results and native restrictions settled; each context consumes the same round outcome once; preserve multi-shot continuation and Scheme winding
clauses.retirement: Replace post-GC next_heap_msection/prepare_mem_pstate choreography and carrier result overwrite assumptions with one resume plan consumer
clauses.custody: Failed capacity admission keeps source before flip; post-flip unknown state forbids Scheme resume; GC movement does not recreate an expired native C activation
clauses.memoryOrder: Acquire seal and interval grant before address reload/resume; publication of a later round cannot erase unacknowledged result storage
clauses.savedWork: Avoid unnecessary carrier-wide acknowledgement and reinference of context capacity; required root repair/reload remains
clauses.addedCost: Per-context receipts, restored interval plans and result retention; resume reserve is not post-peak refund

clauses.oldAuthority: Native thread exit/join result jointly decides membership, work lifetime, roots and cleanup
clauses.replacement: Separate close-execution, freeze heap writes, transfer work/roots, close native users and recycle host slot authorizations
clauses.condition: Prove actual no-write/borrow boundaries and known task transfer; unknown join alone proves neither heap safety nor unsafe heap participation
clauses.retirement: Replace resize abort/shrink and post-run service-loop authority as one lifecycle cut, including accepted callbacks/errors and partial create failure
clauses.custody: VM retains outcomes, roots and resources across carrier loss; known frozen writers may detach with tasks reassigned; unknown shared-heap writers can still block the affected VM
clauses.memoryOrder: Close gates before draining permits; release custody receipt before source ACK; native handle reuse still needs known last native user, not GC completion
clauses.savedWork: Avoid GC veto solely for a safely detached native handle and avoid retaining an entire idle collective just to hold results
clauses.addedCost: Bounded control records plus possibly large rooted graphs/native arenas; exhaustion policy and failure scope explicit

clauses.oldAuthority: cleanup_pstate destroys RC/memory and synchronization after a successful join
clauses.replacement: Separate host cleanup from VM-owned root-domain/arena reclamation and managed-reader grace completion
clauses.condition: No scanner/borrower/late callback uses reclaimed storage; still/RC roots are transferred or proven dead; queued releases retain payload independently of PSTATE
clauses.retirement: Replace cleanup_os_and_mem_pstate lifetime coupling after every cleanup/setup/rollback consumer uses the new domain ownership; keep necessary OS resource release
clauses.custody: Unknown reader/native user prevents physical recycle; metadata cannot be reused across an unresolved incarnation; VM shutdown must drain or explicitly retain
clauses.memoryOrder: Acquired transfer ACK plus reader grace and native-close receipt precede free; managed epoch progress excludes unregistered native readers
clauses.savedWork: Reclaim unrelated healthy domains after qualified closure; do not scan a retired PSTATE solely because it owns RC storage
clauses.addedCost: Grace metadata, delayed native/resource frees and reader tracking; unmanaged borrowers need their own protocol
